title: Breaking free from the predicament
next_chapter_hook: As the guardian spirit beast's figure gradually dissipated, the warning it left echoed endlessly in Chen Ji's heart—Heavenly Eye, what kind of existence was that? Meanwhile, in another part of the secret realm, Chen Nian's figure seemed to sense something, slowly opening her eyes...

text.content: Deep within the secret realm, ancient spiritual energy surged like a tide. Chen Ji stood among the ruins, beneath his feet were青stone slabs eroded by time, and a faint spiritual mist filled the surroundings. The intense battle with the secret realm guardian had left him covered in blood, and the three deep gashes on his left arm, visible down to the bone, were still oozing blood that dripped onto the cracked ground. The deadline of March seventh hung over him like a sword, leaving him no room for slackness. A low growl echoed in the distance—the disturbed guardian spirit beast was approaching following the scent of blood. Chen Ji quickly scanned his surroundings. Among the dilapidated buildings, there seemed to be a hidden place concealed by a formation, but with his current injuries, whether he could hold out until reaching there remained uncertain.

Just then, a massive shadow slowly emerged from the spiritual mist. It was a completely black mysterious snake, its body thick enough to span three zhang, with ancient暗gold patterns flowing across its scales. Its vertical pupils burned with ghostly green fire, coldly gazing at the intruder before it. The guardian spirit beast's pressure bore down like something substantial, making Chen Ji feel even breathing became difficult. Instinctively wanting to circulate spiritual energy to resist, he discovered his body's True Qi had been mostly consumed—he probably couldn't withstand even one strike from this spirit beast. "A servant disciple from Tianqing Sect?" The mysterious snake spoke in a human voice, its tone hoarse and icy cold. "Dare to intrude here, truly courting death." With that, its massive body had already begun coiling, ready to launch a lethal strike at any moment.

dialogue.content: (Wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, slowly straightening up) Senior, please stay your hand. The junior did not intend to offend, only that there are reasons I must come.

text.content: The mysterious snake's vertical pupils slightly contracted, evidently somewhat surprised that this injured servant disciple still dared to speak. But its killing intent diminished not one bit—the ghostly green fire in its pupils burned even more intensely. "Reasons?" It coldly laughed. "Those who intrude forbidden grounds need no reasons." Before the words finished, a blade of spiritual light had already shot from its mouth, directly aimed at Chen Ji's face. The speed was so great Chen Ji barely had time to react—he could only instinctively dodge sideways, barely avoiding the vital point, yet the spiritual light still grazed his shoulder, sending up a spray of blood. The intense pain came, Chen Ji groaned, but gritted his teeth refusing to cry out. Instead, he used this brief moment to stabilize his form, his mind racing through escape strategies.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly began violently vibrating within Chen Ji's body, emitting a faint yet incredibly familiar glow. That light penetrated Chen Ji's clothing, illuminating his chest area, forming an ancient rune mark. The mysterious snake's attack abruptly halted, its vertical pupils contracting sharply into a thin line, staring fixedly at the light on Chen Ji's chest. The original arrogance and coldness on its face was replaced by disbelief. "This is..." Its voice trembled for the first time. "Lord Chen Xuan's bloodline aura?!" Chen Ji's heart stirred—he remembered what Master Mo had once mentioned in the past. Chen Xuan was precisely the creator of this secret realm, and this guardian spirit beast was likely a watcher tamed by Chen Xuan himself. It recognized the Tianji Record's aura and also recognized the unique mark of Chen Xuan's bloodline.

The mysterious snake's massive body slowly retreated several zhang. Complex light flickered in its fire-burning vertical pupils. It re-examined this blood-soaked young man before it, seemingly trying to see through all his secrets. After a long while, it slowly spoke, the killing intent in its voice already greatly diminished: "You carry Lord Chen Xuan's aura, yet also the fluctuating waves of the Tianji Record Fragment... Who exactly are you?" Chen Ji felt that terrifying pressure ease considerably, secretly relieved in his heart. He knew this was his only chance. "Junior Chen Ji," he said candidly. "Am indeed a descendant of Chen Xuan. The Tianji Record Fragment is an heirloom left by my ancestor. Today I came to inherit my ancestor's unfinished ambition." With that, he took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. The ancient page emitted a faint glow in the dim secret realm.

dialogue.content: (Master Mo's aged yet relieved voice comes from within the Tianji Record) Well done, child. Show it your bloodline, let it see that the descendants of Chen Xuan have never abandoned this land.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, following Master Mo's guidance, forcing a wisp of refined blood into the Tianji Record Fragment. In an instant, that ancient page burst forth with dazzling golden light, and a complex, profound formation slowly unfurled in the air. At the center of the formation was a blurry figure's outline. Though the features couldn't be made out, the aura emanating from that figure made the mysterious snake tremble throughout. "This is... Lord Chen Xuan!" The mysterious snake's voice carried a tremor of excitement. "Lord's bloodline imprint left behind!" Its massive head slowly lowered, the ghostly fire in its vertical pupils becoming much gentler. "I have guarded this place for three thousand years, waiting precisely for this moment." Its voice was low and full of emotion. "Descendant of Lord Chen Xuan, you have finally come."

The mysterious snake's massive body began slowly shrinking. The暗gold patterns on its pitch-black scales grew increasingly distinct, eventually taking the form of a middle-aged man dressed in black robes. His features were cold and stern, with a slender golden line between his brows—that was the mysterious snake's life-bound mark. The black-robed man slightly clasped his hands toward Chen Ji, his tone carrying some emotion: "Three thousand years, I have guarded Lord Chen Xuan's final inheritance here. I thought I would never see his descendant in this lifetime, never expected..." His gaze toward Chen Ji held more scrutiny. "Though your cultivation is shallow, being able to remain calm despite severe injuries, and to decisively display your bloodline at a critical moment—this temperament is not bad." He paused, then shifted topics. "However, accepting the inheritance is no child's play. Do you know the price involved?"

choice.prompt: The black-robed man's burning gaze fixed on Chen Ji, awaiting his answer. Accepting the inheritance meant gaining tremendous power, but also meant being drawn into an even deeper vortex; declining the kindness might mean missing a golden opportunity, but at least one could maintain the status quo. The March seventh deadline loomed imminent, Chen Nian's whereabouts remained unknown, and Ling Yuan's schemes were secretly fermenting...

choices.description: Tell the black-robed man he is already prepared, and will bear whatever price regardless. Chen Xuan ancestor's ambition, family grievances, and those he must protect—all of these gave him no reason to retreat.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the guardian spirit beast's inheritance, strength soaring by leaps and bounds
choices.risk_hint: Unknown risks may exist in the inheritance process

dialogue.content: (Eyes determined, tone steady) Senior, since the junior has come, I did not plan to return empty-handed. The ancestor's ambition, family grievances, and those I must protect—all of these leave me no path for retreat. Please bestow the inheritance. Whatever the price, Chen Ji is willing to bear it.

choices.description: Express that one's cultivation is still shallow, fearing one cannot bear such a heavy inheritance, hoping to understand the specific content of the inheritance before deciding. This is a more cautious attitude, but may disappoint the guardian spirit beast.
choices.visible_cost: May miss part of the inheritance content
choices.visible_reward: Displaying caution and wisdom, leaving a good impression
choices.risk_hint: The guardian spirit beast may change its attitude as a result

dialogue.content: (Slightly bowing, respectful tone) Senior's generous favor, the junior is deeply grateful. It's just that the junior's cultivation is shallow, rashly accepting the inheritance would be wasting the ancestor's painstaking efforts. I wonder if Senior could tell me, what exactly does this inheritance contain? What qualifications does one need to fully bear it?

text.content: The black-robed man heard this, a hint of approval flickering in his eyes. "Unhurried and unruffled, quite having some of Lord Chen Xuan's style from back then." He waved his hand, and a ray of spiritual light entered Chen Ji's brow center. Instantly, information about the inheritance flooded into his mind like a tide. The inheritance was divided into three layers: The first layer was the Mysterious Snake True解, an ancient body-refining technique that could make the physical body indestructible; The second layer was the authority to control the secret realm—after receiving the inheritance, he would have the power to mobilize part of this secret realm's resources; The third layer was a wisp of the black-robed man's divine consciousness imprint, which could save his life once at a critical moment. "With your current cultivation, the first layer you can barely withstand; the second layer needs gradual unsealing. As for the third layer..." The black-robed man paused, his expression turning grave. "That is the final insurance I left for you. I hope you never need to use it."

dialogue.content: (Master Mo's voice rings in Chen Ji's mind, carrying excitement) Child, this is a rare opportunity! The Mysterious Snake True解 combined with the Tianji Record's predictive ability is enough to multiply your combat power several times over in a short period. And the secret realm control authority even more so—it's a trump card that can reverse the situation at critical moments!

text.content: Chen Ji felt the massive stream of information in his mind, his heart too excited to contain itself. But his expression still maintained composure, only a trace of hidden light flashing in his eyes. The black-robed man seemed to see through his thoughts, the corners of his mouth slightly rising: "The inheritance can begin immediately, but you should be mentally prepared—the process will by no means be pleasant." The moment his words fell, his form turned into a stream of black light and entered Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, a burning and violent force exploded within Chen Ji's body, as if thousands of tiny snakes were racing and tearing through his meridians. That kind of pain nearly made him faint, but he clenched his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, actually enduring it without making a sound. "Not bad," the black-robed man's voice resounded within his body. "Much more resilient than I expected. Continue to persevere, the first layer of inheritance will complete soon."

Time slowly passed in the torment of pain. Who knows how long later, that burning energy finally gradually calmed. Chen Ji felt his body had undergone an earth-shaking change. Those deep bone-piercing wounds had completely healed, replaced by a faint layer of black scale patterns, barely visible beneath the skin. His physical body's strength had increased by at least threefold, and his meridians were also more than double their former width. More importantly, a complete technique had appeared in his mind—the Mysterious Snake True解, and when circulated, it formed a subtle resonance with the Tianji Record's predictive ability. "The first layer of inheritance is complete," the black-robed man's voice sounded again. "With your aptitude, completing it within half an hour is truly remarkable. Now, I must tell you some secrets about the Tianji Record—and the truth I have guarded for three thousand years, unable to speak until now."

dialogue.content: (Master Mo's voice suddenly tenses) What is it going to say? Secrets of the Tianji Record... Could it know something?

text.content: The black-robed man fell silent for a moment, seemingly considering how to speak. "The Tianji Record is no ordinary treasure," he slowly said. "It is something Lord Chen Xuan seized from the 'Heavenly Eye.'" The moment this name left his mouth, Chen Ji felt the surrounding air freeze solid. "What is the Heavenly Eye?" he asked instinctively. The black-robed man's expression turned exceptionally grave: "That is an existence that transcends all sects, the Demonic Path, even the entire cultivation world. It is formless and incorporeal, yet omnipresent. Every Tianji Record holder throughout history has merely been a chess piece laid out by it—including your ancestor Chen Xuan, and also..." He paused, his gaze complex as he looked at Chen Ji. "You, as things stand." Chen Ji's heart was greatly shaken. Recalling what Master Mo had once said, something in his mind seemed to be gradually connecting. "Then how can I break free from its control?" he asked deeply.

dialogue.content: (Master Mo's voice becomes low) What it says is true. The origins of the Tianji Record are far more complex than what I knew... Child, this volume's objective, you have accomplished the majority. The road ahead must be taken with more care than ever.

text.content: The black-robed man shook his head, his expression carrying helplessness: "Break free from its control? I have guarded this secret realm for three thousand years and found no answer either." He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying more depth. "But Lord Chen Xuan left behind a saying before his fall—'The secret of the Tianji Record lies not within the inheritance, but within the one who guards.' Perhaps the answer is hidden in your sister." Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted, his heart surging with waves. "Chen Nian?" he nearly blurted out. "What connection does she have with the Tianji Record?" The black-robed man gave no direct answer, but took out an ancient-looking jade pendant from his chest and handed it to Chen Ji. "This is the final token I leave for you," he said. "When you find your sister, give it to her. She will tell you everything. Now, the secret realm is about to close. You should leave." With those words, a spatial rift slowly tore open before Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: On the other side of the spatial rift, light faintly penetrated through. That was the exit leaving the secret realm. The black-robed man's form had already begun becoming illusory, clearly unable to sustain much longer. Before leaving, does Chen Ji have words he wishes to say, or matters he needs to confirm?

choices.description: Before leaving, pursue the black-robed man for more information about Chen Nian. Time is pressing, but the sister's whereabouts are the most important clue at present.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, may miss the optimal departure time
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining more key information about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The secret realm is about to close, accidents may occur

dialogue.content: (Hurriedly stepping forward) Senior, regarding my sister—Chen Nian—what else do you know? Where is she now? I must find her as soon as possible!

choices.description: Bear the black-robed man's warning in heart, and leave the secret realm with the inheritance token and jade pendant. The clue regarding the sister already has an inkling. Next, it requires careful planning.
choices.visible_reward: Safely leaving the secret realm, preserving strength

dialogue.content: (Taking a deep breath, solemnly clasping hands) Senior's teachings, Chen Ji will forever remember in heart. The Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian, and this jade pendant—I will investigate each and every one. Farewell!

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, leaping into the spatial rift. The sensation of crossing the rift was like falling into an endless abyss. All around was chaotic darkness, and in his ears was the howling of wind. Just as he was about to be swallowed by the darkness, the black-robed man's final voice sounded in his mind: "Remember, child—the Heavenly Eye is everywhere. The future you see may be exactly what it wants you to see. Until you are strong enough, do not casually use all the abilities of the Tianji Record." The words fell, Chen Ji felt light before his eyes, and his body heavily fell onto hard ground. He raised his head and discovered he was already in the valley outside the secret realm. In the distance, Tianqing Sect's main peak loomed indistinctly, and in an even further direction, the domain of the Holy Sect was shrouded in诡异 purple mist. March seventh, only three days remaining. Chen Ji tightly gripped the jade pendant in his hand, a resolute light flickering in his eyes. Sister, wait for me. This time, he was no longer the waste servant everyone could bully, but a descendant of Chen Xuan carrying the ancestor's ambition and the guardian spirit beast's inheritance. His chess
